terms.name: 扇区化零法
terms.meaning: Transform sector [k1,k2] to a zero-lower-bound sector via H=G/(1+k1*G) and subtract the lower-slope term from the nonlinearity; not cancellation of the entire nonlinearity.

terms.name: 严格无源阻抗
terms.meaning: Original impedance definition Re Z(jw) > delta > 0 for all real frequencies; distinguish this uniform real-part lower bound from more general strictly-positive-real definitions.

terms.name: 积分器抗漂移控制方法
terms.meaning: Integrator anti-windup local feedback activated by actuator saturation; not generic leakage or sensor drift removal.

terms.meaning: l is lowercase Latin ell, the derivative/integrator order; input phi=y^(l), inverse block maps phi to u. A single OCR subscript t is inconsistent with the surrounding l notation.
